Record Class AotCacheGate.Coverage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.runner.build.aotcache.AotCacheGate.Coverage
Record Components:
classesLoaded - the classes it loaded
classesFromCache - how many of them came from the cache
micronautLoaded - the io.micronaut classes it loaded
micronautFromCache - how many of them came from the cache
micronautNotFromCache - the names of the others, in load order
unexpected - those of them that are neither lambda proxies nor skipped by the recording
runtimeLambdas - the lambda proxy classes it spun instead of loading them from the cache
Enclosing class:
AotCacheGate
public static record AotCacheGate.Coverage(int classesLoaded, int classesFromCache, int micronautLoaded, int micronautFromCache, List<String> micronautNotFromCache, List<String> unexpected, int runtimeLambdas) extends Record
What a strict launch took from the cache.
Since:
1.0
